annotations.text:
Simpler palette: seven values, six of them neutral. The wooden board is gone (bone and graphite squares), and the last move is an inset accent rule rather than a coloured fill, so the accent is the only chroma on the page.
Nothing is stacked in one rail any more: global controls sit in the top bar, the board is dead-centre, and each flanking column does one job. History is its own full-width section below the fold.
